name: shopId
label: E-shop

nested.name: projectId
nested.label: Project
nested.help: Project (output feed) of the selected e-shop; the output channel is in brackets. To enter a project ID instead, switch on Map.

help: Mergado e-shop. The list shows the e-shops your Mergado account has access to.

name: mql
label: MQL query
help: Condition in Mergado Query Language, for example `PRICE_VAT < 100`. It is evaluated on the input values of the products. Element names are case-sensitive. Leave empty to return all products.

name: isHidden
label: Visibility
help: Leave empty to return both visible and hidden products.

name: valuesToExtract
label: Values to extract
help: Comma-separated element paths or variable names, for example `ITEM_ID,PRICE_VAT,PARAM | PARAM_NAME`. The response then contains only these values in Extracted values instead of all product data.

name: limit
label: Limit
help: Maximum number of products Make will return during one execution cycle.
